findings.finding: A persisted review row was mandatory only for controller-unavailable reviews. For an ordinary configured reviewer, review_record=None fell through and returned true, so a missing DB review row did not fail closed.
findings.required_change: Require a persisted review_record dict for both normal and unavailable review branches, then match reviewed_version, reviewer_id, and status to the exact attempt/result review.

confirmed_constraints: Controller unavailable tuple and result review equality were constrained correctly.
Result/attempt/HTML and manifest/launch checks remained strict.
